description: World Organizations: Research Bodies Societies Funders and Publishers. A world directory of organizations that are not just companies or governments. For research tools, grant finders, CRM enrichment, maps, education apps and AI agents. Routes: /gaps (kind, form, min_population, limit, offset); /{id}; /forms; /kinds; /nearby (lat*, lon*, kind, form, limit); /search (q, country, kind, form, source, sort, limit, offset); /countries (country, kind, form, sort, limit, offset); /nonprofits/{ein}; /nonprofits/causes (state); /nonprofits/search (q, state, city, postcode, kind, cause, min_revenue, max_revenue, sort, limit, offset); /nonprofits/states (cause, sort). Paid $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.
